top_stories.title: Wikipedia bans AI-generated articles
top_stories.summary: Wikipedia has officially banned the publication of AI-generated articles after concerns about inaccuracies, bias, and the difficulty of identifying machine-produced texts. The move highlights growing tension over the reliability and sourcing of content created by large language models in public information platforms.

top_stories.title: OpenAI shelves erotic chatbot ‘indefinitely’
top_stories.summary: OpenAI has decided to indefinitely halt its planned release of an erotic chatbot mode, following significant internal and external pushback over potential abuses and reputational risks. This signals ongoing industry debate about the boundaries and safeguards for generative AI applications.

top_stories.title: Webtoon is adding AI localization tools to its comics platform
top_stories.summary: Webtoon is launching AI-powered translation and localization tools to make its comics more accessible globally. This initiative aims to bridge language barriers and accelerate release schedules, reflecting a broader trend of integrating AI into creative, language-driven industries.

top_stories.title: Meta is laying off hundreds of employees as it pours money into AI
top_stories.summary: Meta has announced hundreds of layoffs within its business group, reallocating resources to focus on AI development and infrastructure. The shift indicates intensified investment in AI across big tech, even as it results in significant organizational restructuring.

top_stories.title: Protecting people from harmful manipulation
top_stories.summary: Google DeepMind details ongoing research and policy efforts to identify, mitigate, and prevent manipulative uses of AI systems, especially in large language models and content recommendation. The company outlines emerging technical safeguards and policy recommendations, emphasizing the societal risks of AI-driven misinformation.

further_links.title: Disney’s big bets on the metaverse and AI slop aren’t going so well
further_links.summary: A closer look at Disney's forays into AI-powered content and the metaverse, and why the company's ambitious projects have faced difficulties.

further_links.title: Senators Demand to Know How Much Energy Data Centers Use
further_links.summary: US Senators are pressing for data on the electricity consumption of data centers, amid concerns about AI's contribution to rising power demands.

further_links.title: Why Not Use AI to Cross the Language Barrier in Academic Publishing?
further_links.summary: This article explores the rising use of AI translation tools to make academic publishing more accessible globally, along with the associated legal and quality challenges.

further_links.title: Lyria 3 Pro: Create longer tracks in more
further_links.summary: Google DeepMind introduces Lyria 3 Pro, an AI music model that enables users to create longer and more complex tracks, expanding creative AI capabilities.

further_links.title: Oracle Fusion’s New Agentic AI: Automating the Future of Enterprise Work
further_links.summary: Oracle’s latest agentic AI features in its Fusion platform are designed to automate complex tasks, marking a significant step in enterprise AI adoption.

further_links.title: OpenAI Enters Its Focus Era by Killing Sora
further_links.summary: OpenAI has discontinued its Sora project, signaling a strategic refocus on core AI products and reducing distractions from its primary mission.

further_links.title: Google Lyria 3 Pro makes longer AI songs
further_links.summary: A user-level perspective on Google’s Lyria 3 Pro, highlighting how the AI model advances music track length and creative potential.

further_links.title: Wiring the intelligent enterprise for the year ahead - 2026 will be a year of reckoning for AI
further_links.summary: Analysis of upcoming trends and challenges in enterprise AI adoption, with predictions for major shifts in organizational technology by 2026.

further_links.title: EU backs nude app ban and delays to landmark AI rules
further_links.summary: The European Union has supported a ban on 'nudify' apps using AI and delayed the implementation of key AI regulatory rules, signaling complex policy debates.

further_links.title: Oracle: AI agents can reason, decide and act - liability question remains
further_links.summary: Oracle discusses how its new AI agents are capable of reasoning and acting autonomously, though questions over legal liability and decision-making persist.

further_links.title: Senate Democrats are trying to ‘codify’ Anthropic’s red lines on autonomous weapons and mass surveillance
further_links.summary: Senators have proposed legislation that would enshrine Anthropic's voluntary guidelines on banning AI uses in autonomous weaponry and surveillance in law.

ethan_mollick.title: How I Use AI: The Tools, The Tips, and The Techniques
ethan_mollick.summary: Ethan Mollick provides a comprehensive overview of his current AI workflow, detailing the tools and methods he uses for productivity, teaching, and research. He discusses best practices for integrating large language models, automation, and related AI resources into daily professional life, supported by practical, real-world outcomes.
